records.quote:
Booth number seven
was where he had fled for concealment and received a double dose of
drug injection! It was no wonder he was suffering the excessive lag in
thermal adjustment!
records.paraphrase: The double dose of the thermal retardation drug is the cause of his uncontrolled thermal suffering.

records.quote:
It was the nutrient tube which
would feed him for some nine months in space.
records.paraphrase: Passengers are fed intravenously for the nine-month voyage.

records.quote:
"Astonishing!" the Marsfield Surgeon-General exclaimed. "Simply
astonishing the survival power you people have given your passengers
with this new drug combination.
records.paraphrase: The Surgeon-General marvels that the drug combination kept Pauker alive despite his condition.

records.quote:
Actually, the temperature of the air is held carefully at 98.6
degrees, Fahrenheit, the exact temperature of the normal human body.
This is to help minimize your bodies' metabolism, or fuel consumption.
records.paraphrase: Cabin air is held at body temperature to minimize passenger metabolism.

records.quote:
At his heels, the squat, robot
luggage-carrier dutifully followed the "bone" which he carried in his
right hand.
records.paraphrase: A robot luggage-carrier follows a handheld homing device.

records.quote:
This was no ocean liner where you could wander about, swim and play
shuffle-board. You bought your ticket, lay down and played dead for
nine months. It was part of the contract.
records.paraphrase: Passengers remain immobilized for the entire nine-month journey by contract.

records.quote:
You stepped in, placing your feet on the painted foot-prints,
slipped the steel I.D. plate containing your metabolic data into the
slot, and _click_, a measured dose of anti-this-or-that serum shot from
a compressed air needle and penetrated the proper area of the body
without breaking the skin.
records.paraphrase: An automated inoculation booth injects serum using compressed air based on stored metabolic data.

records.quote:
It was the nutrient tube which
would feed him for some nine months in space.
records.paraphrase: The journey to Mars spans nine months across space.

records.quote:
One injection relaxes all your muscles, which, in turn, lowers your
metabolism and makes intravenous feeding adequate. You will know no
hunger or nausea, even when we go into free-flight.
records.paraphrase: A muscle-relaxing injection lowers metabolism to make intravenous feeding sufficient.

records.quote:
the feeding was based on your
metabolism tests and the assumption that your temperature was swinging
between narrow limits. And it didn't account for the energy you are
using coughing!
records.paraphrase: The intravenous feeding cannot compensate for the extra energy his abnormal reactions consume.

records.quote:
It was, of course, out
of order. For it registered only an absurd ten days, six hours and
fourteen minutes since blast-off
records.paraphrase: The chronometer shows only ten days have passed, contrasting with the perceived length of his ordeal.

records.quote:
See here," he prodded Pauker's
emaciated ribs. "He still reacts to stimulus. Good as dead, yet I doubt
that he fully lost consciousness the whole trip!"
records.paraphrase: The Surgeon-General notes Pauker remained conscious and near death through the entire trip.

records.quote:
Pauker was not religious, but he prayed to God for life, then he prayed
to the devil for death
records.paraphrase: Pauker, overwhelmed by suffering, alternately prays for life and death.

records.quote:
each
passenger now receives a minute injection of a retardation drug that
has the desired effect. This drug creates a slight lag between the time
of heat sensation and the beginning of perspiration.
records.paraphrase: A retardation drug deliberately induces a lag in the body's perspiration response.

records.quote:
most interplanetary trippers used the lightest, flimsiest
containers to remain under the 100-pound limit
records.paraphrase: Interplanetary travel with baggage weight limits is routine in this world.

criteria.rationale: The story materially deploys physiological and pharmacological science: metabolism reduction via muscle-relaxant injection, body-temperature air control at 98.6F to minimize fuel consumption, and a thermal-adjustment retardation drug that manipulates the perspiration reflex. These scientific processes are explained in detail and drive Pauker's fate.

Engineered systems materially drive the plot: the automated compressed-air inoculation booths (where the fatal double dose occurs), intravenous nutrient feeding for a nine-month voyage, and the robot luggage-carrier following a homing 'bone'. The inoculation booth technology is directly causal to Pauker's suffering.

The story is set in a speculative future of routine interplanetary travel, with a nine-month spaceflight to Mars and established bubble-cities. This future setting is the frame for the entire narrative.

The story rigorously extrapolates consequences from an identifiable premise: a retardation drug calibrated to metabolic assumptions. When Pauker receives a double dose and his coughing consumes extra energy, the feeding regimen and thermal control break down, producing his prolonged torture. The plot is the working-out of these physiological consequences.

Although the drug system rests on prior metabolism testing, no character within the story performs observation, hypothesis-testing, measurement, or evidential revision to drive understanding or action. Pauker merely deduces why he suffers; the Surgeon-General only exclaims in wonder. Scientific method is not materially dramatized.

Mars is the destination, with described bubble-cities and the luxury metropolis Marsfield where the story concludes; Pauker is a visitor traveling to another planet. The extraterrestrial setting is materially part of the storyworld.

The story centers on one criminal's personal medical ordeal aboard a routine flight. There is no large-scale natural, technological, cosmic, biological, or human-caused disaster; the suffering is individual, not catastrophic in scale.

candidates.description: The interplanetary passenger-transport system that renders passengers into a drug-induced state of near-suspended animation for the nine-month voyage: intravenous feeding, a muscle-relaxant that lowers metabolism to near-paralysis, a body-temperature cabin held at 98.6F to minimize fuel consumption, and especially a thermal-adjustment retardation drug that deliberately induces oscillating warmth/chill sensations. This integrated bio-medical travel regimen is the totalizing difference that structures the entire storyworld and drives the fatal consequence when Pauker receives a double dose in booth seven.

novelty.rationale: The described mode of interplanetary travel, in which every passenger is chemically immobilized, intravenously fed, held at body temperature, and given a retardation drug to manage thermal sensation across a nine-month voyage, is a world-altering difference from the empirical norm and forms the constitutive condition of the story's universe.

cognitive_validation.rationale: The story supplies a coherent, systematic, immanent, nonsupernatural pseudo-biological rationale: muscle relaxant lowers metabolism to make IV feeding adequate; constant 98.6F reduces fuel consumption; the retardation drug creates a lag between heat sensation and perspiration to keep thermal control 'functioning' and prevent respiratory illness; and a double dose logically extends the lag into uncontrolled fever, extra caloric burn from coughing, and inadequate feeding. The causal chain is internally consistent.

narrative_hegemony.rationale: The immobilization-and-retardation-drug regimen governs the overriding narrative logic: the crime plot's escape depends on the voyage, the accidental double dose in booth seven determines the protagonist's fate, and the entire second half is the cascading consequence of the drug system malfunctioning. The story's ironic ending turns entirely on this novum.

estrangement.rationale: The chronometer reading only ten days against Pauker's subjective eternity of suffering, and the Surgeon-General's clinical astonishment at the drug's 'survival power,' estrange the reader by contrasting the corporation's comforting sales-pitch framing of the drug regimen with its actual torturous consequence.

candidates.description: A squat, three-wheeled robot luggage-carrier that autonomously follows a handheld 'bone' homing device.

novelty.rationale: An autonomous homing robot porter is a modest technological difference from the empirical norm, but it is presented as ordinary background infrastructure rather than a world-altering transformation.

cognitive_validation.rationale: The homing-'bone' mechanism implies a coherent tracking principle but is barely developed, so the cognitive account is thin though nonsupernatural.

narrative_hegemony.rationale: The robot carrier is an incidental atmospheric device; it does not determine the narrative logic or drive the plot.

estrangement.rationale: The robot porter following a 'bone' provides local futuristic texture but no story-level estrangement.

candidates.description: An automated maze of inoculation booths that reads a steel I.D. plate of metabolic data and delivers measured serum/drug doses via compressed-air needle without human contact.

novelty.rationale: Automated data-driven inoculation is a plausible near-future extrapolation but not itself a totalizing world difference; it is a delivery mechanism for the drug regimen.

cognitive_validation.rationale: The booth's operation is described coherently and mechanistically: I.D. plate with metabolic data drives a measured compressed-air injection, a systematic nonsupernatural account.

narrative_hegemony.rationale: The booth is the vehicle by which Pauker receives his fatal double dose, so it is plot-relevant, but the governing novum is the drug regimen it administers; the booth itself is instrumental rather than the overriding narrative logic.

estrangement.rationale: The touchless, painless automated inoculation contrasts with the 'brutal hypo-punching' of the past, offering local estrangement subordinate to the drug-regimen novum.
